task_focus: 把 phase bus / Q_phi 从解释性概念压缩成工程反馈回路；目标不是写论文，而是找真实理论突破和科技进步杠杆。
polaris: RP 镍酸盐 bulk SC 的关键工程变量不是简单消灭 DW，而是在保留局域 pairing fluctuation 的同时，把 Ni dz2/apical-O/dz2 通道恢复成足够低退相干的层间相位总线。

framework.borrowed_structure: 局域节点已经能形成短程配对，但全局态只有在链路容量超过噪声和分区损耗时才通过 quorum；工程上不需要证明每个节点完美，只需要把可测输入推过可复现的 quorum 阈值。
framework.physics_translation: NiO2 层/局域配对区是节点，dz2-pz-dz2 层间谱权重是链路容量，static DW/domain 是分区损耗，Gamma_phi 是相位消息退相干，bulk shielding/THz/Josephson 是全局共识成功信号。

predictor.name: I_phi
predictor.formula: I_phi = E_z2 * C_phi / max(k_B*T + hbar*Gamma_phi, E_floor)

unit_protocol.E_z2: energy scale in meV or eV derived from dz2/pz c-axis coherent spectral weight; if the raw observable is a dimensionless normalized weight W_z2, use E_z2 = E0 * W_z2 with E0 declared before fitting
unit_protocol.C_phi: dimensionless 0 to 1 connectivity factor from domain fraction, structural correlation length, layer registry, or kz/orbital coherence; it must not contain shielding, THz phase stiffness, or Josephson output
unit_protocol.Gamma_phi: angular-frequency dephasing rate in s^-1; hbar*Gamma_phi is an energy
unit_protocol.E_floor: larger of instrumental energy resolution, residual disorder floor, and the minimum fitted dephasing floor; prevents T,Gamma_phi -> 0 divergence

predictor.engineering_rule: Use I_phi only as a design score and feedback coordinate. Q_c/I_c is calibrated after the fact by independent bulk outputs, not inserted into the predictor.

compressed_technology_routes.name: pressure or c-axis strain phase-bus feedback loop
compresses_round2_routes: R1 hydrostatic pressure plus c-axis optical/THz
R2 uniaxial strain and orbital-resolved control
compressed_technology_routes.why_high_value: This is the cleanest route from mechanism to technology: continuously tune dz2-pz-dz2 overlap and immediately observe whether the phase bus turns on before bulk SC. It tests causality and gives an actuator for optimization.
actuator: hydrostatic pressure P as fast mapping axis
then c-axis uniaxial compression epsilon_c = -(c-c0)/c0 as the cleaner actuator once the pressure window is known
input_measurements_for_feedback: E_z2 from normal-state or just-above-onset c-axis optical Drude/spectral weight, polarization-resolved O K-edge pz weight, Ni L-edge dz2 redistribution, or ARPES kz dispersion
C_phi from single-domain fraction, x-ray/neutron structural correlation length, trilayer registry, and static-DW/domain imaging
Gamma_phi from RIXS linewidth, ultrafast dephasing, or low-frequency optical/THz linewidth measured in the normal/onset-preceding window
controls: ab-plane Drude weight or bandwidth proxy, Hall number, residual resistivity/disorder proxy, pressure structural phase fraction
output_measurements_not_used_in_predicto: c-axis Josephson plasma edge or independent THz phase-stiffness onset
vertical Josephson-like tunneling response if device geometry allows

go_thresholds.input_threshold: Across the same sample or tightly matched series, I_phi must increase by at least 2x or by >=3 sigma relative to the low-pressure/low-strain baseline before or at the first bulk-SC output.
go_thresholds.spectral_threshold: E_z2 or its declared proxy must recover by >=15% and >=3 sigma while the ab-plane Drude/bandwidth proxy changes by less than half that normalized effect or is explicitly included as a nuisance covariate.
go_thresholds.connectivity_threshold: C_phi must be >=0.70 or, if lower, must be measured point-by-point and still leave I_phi predictive after domain correction.
go_thresholds.dephasing_threshold: hbar*Gamma_phi must not increase enough to erase the E_z2 gain; operationally I_phi, not E_z2 alone, must pass the >=2x or >=3 sigma rule.
go_thresholds.bulk_success_threshold: Count bulk SC only if shielding volume fraction is >=10% with reproducible Meissner/vortex evidence, or if zero resistance is accompanied by an independent THz/Josephson phase-stiffness signal.
go_thresholds.sequence_threshold: A valid phase-bus result requires input-side I_phi recovery to precede or coincide with shielding/THz/Josephson onset within experimental temperature/pressure resolution; DW weakening alone is not sufficient.

failure_conditions: I_phi doubles or rises by >=3 sigma across the tuning path but shielding remains <1% and no independent THz/Josephson phase-stiffness signal appears.
bulk shielding >=10% appears while E_z2, C_phi, and Gamma_phi remain flat within error, and the transition is instead predicted by ab-plane Drude/bandwidth or structural phase fraction.
The apparent E_z2 gain disappears after separating Drude weight from scattering rate, contact geometry, cracks, and domain reorientation.
The same sample cannot reproduce the I_phi-output sequence on pressure/strain cycling within stated hysteresis error.
engineering_feedback_loop: measure input variables at a non-superconducting or onset-preceding point
compute I_phi with a predeclared E0/E_floor convention
adjust P or epsilon_c toward larger I_phi while holding Hall number, ab bandwidth, and domains as controls
only after input update, measure shielding/THz/Josephson output
iterate the actuator; stop if failure conditions fire

compressed_technology_routes.name: orthogonal-material-axis phase-bus selector
compresses_round2_routes: R3 chemical-pressure and oxygen-stoichiometry split tuning
compressed_technology_routes.why_high_value: This route separates the hidden variables that pressure entangles. It can decide whether the lever is really dz2 phase-bus capacity or merely carrier density, disorder, heating, or generic bandwidth.
actuator: isovalent chemical pressure / rare-earth radius / epitaxial constraint to change dz2-pz-dz2 overlap
oxygen stoichiometry as an explicitly separate carrier/disorder axis
optional mid-IR apical-oxygen pump as a transient actuator only after the static selector identifies a viable E_z2 direction
input_measurements_for_feedback: E_z2 from O K-edge pz/pxy ratio, Ni L-edge dz2 weight, normal-state c-axis optical spectral weight, or layer-resolved DFT/DMFT hopping calibrated to spectroscopy
C_phi from phase fraction, domain fraction, trilayer structural coherence, and static-DW partition geometry
Gamma_phi from RIXS/ultrafast linewidth or pump-probe dephasing
controls: Hall number, oxygen stoichiometry, residual resistivity, structural phase fraction, ab-plane Drude/bandwidth
output_measurements_not_used_in_predicto: absolute shielding fraction from magnetometry or mutual inductance
THz phase stiffness/Josephson-like plasma response in a separate spectral window from E_z2 extraction
vertical Josephson/tunneling critical response when available

go_thresholds.matched_series_threshold: At least two pairs of samples or states must have Hall number matched within 5%, residual-resistivity/disorder proxy within 10%, and oxygen stoichiometry uncertainty <=0.01 oxygen per formula unit or an equivalent stated metrology floor.
go_thresholds.orthogonal_leverage_threshold: Within those matched pairs, the high-I_phi member must show >=20% or >=3 sigma larger E_z2/C_phi-corrected phase-bus score than the low-I_phi member.
go_thresholds.output_threshold: The high-I_phi member must show >=5x larger shielding fraction, or cross from <1% shielding to >=10% shielding, or show an independent THz/Josephson onset absent in the matched low-I_phi member.
go_thresholds.pump_threshold: For pump tests, the claimed transient phase-bus response must appear within the coherent phonon/electronic window and before the lattice-temperature proxy reaches the equilibrium-heating control; pump-induced reflectivity alone is not enough.
go_thresholds.retention_threshold: DW fluctuations/local gap evidence may remain, but static DW partition/domain signatures must be reduced or bypassed enough that C_phi improves by >=3 sigma.

failure_conditions: All superconducting improvement collapses onto Hall number, oxygen stoichiometry, residual disorder, or structural phase fraction after matched-pair correction.
Chemical pressure increases ab bandwidth but E_z2/C_phi does not improve and no robust shielding/THz/Josephson output follows.
Pump response is reproduced by off-resonant heating, normal conductivity enhancement, or DW melting with no independent phase-stiffness-specific signal.
The best-I_phi sample still gives only zero resistance without >=10% shielding or independent phase stiffness, indicating filamentary or two-dimensional superconductivity.
engineering_feedback_loop: build a small orthogonal matrix: chemical-pressure axis crossed with oxygen/carrier axis
preselect states by high I_phi at matched Hall/disorder
test only the preselected states for bulk outputs
use pump as a reversible perturbation to confirm whether apical-O/dz2 motion can transiently move I_phi without changing stoichiometry
promote only actuators that improve output through I_phi rather than through common third variables

bandwidth_only.claim_to_exclude: pressure/strain/chemistry works only by broadening in-plane bands or changing generic correlation strength.
minimum_conditions: Measure an ab-plane bandwidth proxy, preferably ab Drude weight or a band-structure/ARPES proxy, on the same tuning path.
Find at least one matched comparison where the ab bandwidth proxy is equal within 10% or statistically covaried out, but I_phi differs by >=3 sigma.

Show the bulk output follows I_phi rather than ab bandwidth: either shielding/THz/Josephson turns on only in the high-I_phi state, or a two-variable fit has a statistically necessary I_phi coefficient while bandwidth-only fit fails within error.
If bandwidth and I_phi are locked together for all accessible states, bandwidth-only is not excluded; the route remains suggestive, not decisive.

scattering_domain_only.claim_to_exclude: rho_c/rho_ab, optical changes, or apparent phase-bus recovery are caused by scattering anisotropy, cracks, contacts, or domain reorientation rather than coherent dz2-pz-dz2 capacity.
minimum_conditions: Do not use rho_c/rho_ab as the primary input; use optical sum-rule spectral weight, polarization-resolved orbital weight, kz dispersion, or declared E_z2 proxy.
Separate Drude spectral weight from linewidth/scattering rate; an apparent conductivity gain caused only by narrower Gamma is not enough unless I_phi still rises after the dephasing penalty.
Image or otherwise quantify domains/phase fraction; require single-domain fraction >=80% or include measured domain fraction in C_phi.
Rule out cracks/contact geometry by reproducible cycling and at least one contact-independent probe such as optical/THz/XAS/ARPES/RIXS.
If domain fraction changes explain both E_z2 proxy and output without residual I_phi leverage, scattering/domain-only is not excluded.

common_third_variable_only.claim_to_exclude: oxygen stoichiometry, carrier density, disorder, structural phase fraction, or heating controls both phase-bus proxy and superconductivity.
minimum_conditions: Measure Hall number or an equivalent carrier-density proxy and match it within 5% for at least one decisive comparison.
Measure oxygen stoichiometry with uncertainty <=0.01 per formula unit or use a stated sample-specific metrology limit; do not infer stoichiometry from Tc or transport.
Match residual-resistivity/disorder proxy within 10% or explicitly include it as a covariate.
Measure structural phase fraction; require the target phase fraction >=90% or include phase fraction in C_phi.
For pump tests, use off-resonant and fluence-matched heating controls; the phase-stiffness output must exceed the heating control by >=3 sigma in the same time window.
If no crossed trajectory exists with same carrier/disorder but different I_phi, common-third-variable-only remains open.

non_circular_validation_protocol.fixed_rule: Inputs and outputs are disjoint. A quantity used to construct I_phi cannot be reused as proof that I_phi caused superconductivity.

spectral_weight: normal-state or onset-preceding E_z2 from c-axis optical sum-rule spectral weight
ARPES kz dispersion or DFT/DMFT hopping only when calibrated to spectroscopy
structure: apical oxygen distance or trilayer registry
domain fraction and structural correlation length
static-DW partition geometry as a penalty in C_phi
orbital_and_dephasing: RIXS or ultrafast dephasing linewidth Gamma_phi
normal-state low-frequency linewidth used only as dephasing penalty, not as output stiffness
forbidden_inputs: THz phase stiffness used as the output
Josephson plasma edge used as the output
rho_c/rho_ab if it is later used as validation

allowed_outputs: bulk shielding fraction from magnetometry or mutual inductance
THz phase stiffness or Josephson plasma onset measured in a predeclared output window distinct from the input spectral-weight extraction
zero resistance only as secondary support, never as sole success
output_side.minimum_bulk_call: bulk SC requires shielding >=10% or independent phase-stiffness/Josephson evidence; zero resistance alone is labeled filamentary/transport-only.

workflow: Predeclare which observables define E_z2, C_phi, Gamma_phi, E_floor, and which observables define output.
Measure input variables at T above the bulk transition or before the actuator reaches the output-onset point.
Compute I_phi without using any output variable.
Predict go/no-go: high-I_phi states should be the only states that produce shielding/THz/Josephson output.
Measure outputs blind to the fitted I_phi threshold when possible.
Audit alternatives with bandwidth, scattering/domain, and common-third-variable minimum exclusion conditions.

A curve cannot serve twice: if c-axis THz spectral weight is used for E_z2, use shielding or Josephson tunneling as output; if THz phase stiffness is the output, use XAS/ARPES/normal-state optical weight as input.

single_experiment_recommendation.recommendation: If resources only allow one experiment, do pressure-tuned La4Ni3O10 on the same high-quality single crystal with input-side c-axis/orbital spectral tracking above/onset-preceding Tc and output-side bulk shielding plus independent THz/Josephson phase stiffness, while simultaneously measuring ab-plane Drude/Hall/domain controls.
single_experiment_recommendation.minimal_version: Map P and T through the reported DW-collapse/SC-emergence window. At each pressure, first measure normal-state E_z2/C_phi/Gamma_phi proxies; then measure shielding and a separate phase-stiffness/Josephson output. Do not count zero resistance alone.
single_experiment_recommendation.why_this_one: It tests the central causal order directly: phase-bus recovery -> bulk phase stiffness/shielding, rather than DW weakening or bandwidth alone -> SC. It also produces the first calibration of I_phi/Q_c, which every other route needs.
single_experiment_recommendation.decisive_success: Before or at bulk onset, I_phi rises by >=2x or >=3 sigma, shielding reaches >=10% or an independent THz/Josephson output appears, and ab bandwidth/Hall/domain controls cannot explain the transition alone.
single_experiment_recommendation.decisive_failure: Across the pressure path, bulk output tracks ab bandwidth, carrier density, structural phase fraction, or heating/domain changes while I_phi is flat or nonpredictive; or I_phi improves strongly with no bulk output.

claims.statement: The highest-value technology lever is a closed feedback loop on I_phi, not pressure, DW amplitude, or rho_c/rho_ab by themselves.
assumptions: E_z2 can be extracted or bounded by orbital/c-axis spectroscopy.
C_phi can be measured well enough to penalize domains and static-DW partitions.
Bulk outputs can be measured independently from input spectral proxies.

claims.statement: The critical falsifier is not whether DW disappears, but whether high I_phi predicts shielding/THz/Josephson after bandwidth, scattering/domain, and third-variable controls are imposed.
equations: success requires output(high I_phi | matched bandwidth, Hall, disorder, domains) > output(low I_phi | same controls)
assumptions: At least one crossed or matched trajectory can be produced.
Shielding fraction and phase stiffness are measured, not inferred from zero resistance.

claims.statement: If no actuator can move I_phi independently of common third variables, LP28 remains an organizing interpretation but not yet a technology lever.
equations: engineering leverage = partial derivative(output)/partial derivative(I_phi) at fixed Hall, disorder, bandwidth, and domain fraction
assumptions: Matched-pair or multiaxis tuning is experimentally feasible.

strangest_prediction: There should exist a window where static DW signatures are not fully gone and local pairing/fluctuation evidence survives, yet bulk shielding appears because I_phi crossed quorum. Conversely, a state with weaker DW but no E_z2/C_phi recovery should stay filamentary, metallic, or two-dimensional.
a_objection: A 博士最可能反对：这些阈值是工程经验线，不是微观定理；压力仍然多变量纠缠。回应：Round 3 的目标正是把理论突破降落成可杀死的反馈协议。若在匹配 bandwidth/Hall/disorder/domain 后 I_phi 仍不能预测 shielding/THz/Josephson，就让 phase-bus 方案失败，而不是继续讲故事。
failed_jumps: 纯泵浦路线作为首选失败：时间分辨实验诱人，但 heating/domain/DW melting 替代解释太强，除非先由静态压力或应变确定可移动的 E_z2 方向。
只做化学系列失败：样品差异和氧 stoichiometry 会把 common-third-variable 风险放大；它适合做第二路线的正交排除，不适合作为唯一首实验。
rho_c/rho_ab 反馈失败：它容易把 scattering/contact/domain 当作 phase bus，最多作为下游症状或辅助控制。

deepening.level_1: distributed consensus maps bulk SC to quorum rather than local pairing existence.
deepening.level_2: control theory adds the key move: define a sensor vector (E_z2,C_phi,Gamma_phi), an actuator (P,epsilon_c,chemistry,pump), a forbidden feedback leak (shielding/THz/Josephson cannot enter the predictor), and a go/no-go output.
deepening.physics_payoff: The breakthrough is not a new name for interlayer coherence; it is a non-circular actuator-sensor-output protocol that can optimize nickelate bulk superconductivity or kill the phase-bus hypothesis quickly.

inspector_check.formula: I_phi = E_z2*C_phi/max(k_B*T + hbar*Gamma_phi, E_floor), where E_z2 and E_floor are energies, C_phi is dimensionless, Gamma_phi is s^-1, and I_phi is dimensionless.
inspector_check.direction: Increasing E_z2 or C_phi raises phase-bus score; increasing T, Gamma_phi, disorder floor, domain partition, or static-DW decoupling lowers it.
inspector_check.data: Used only the requested Round 2 synthesis, knowledge base, B Round 2, B Round 2 inspector report, AHA record, and project SOP/state files; did not read A Round 3 output.
inspector_check.assumptions: Thresholds are operational go/no-go rules for same-sample or matched-series experiments, not universal constants. They must be tightened after first calibration.
